raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "0.2.5" %}
{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-ztable
  version: {{ version|replace("-", "_") }}

source:
  url:
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/ztable_{{ version }}.tar.gz
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/ztable/ztable_{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 5264568c553f6ada40f4fdfc5a41c957b67cb9618793293a773684536a2bc002

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: generic
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ posix }}zip               # [win]
  host:
    - r-base
    - r-rcolorbrewer
    - r-flextable
    - r-magrittr
    - r-officer
    - r-rstudioapi
    - r-scales
    - r-stringr
  run:
    - r-base
    - r-rcolorbrewer
    - r-flextable
    - r-magrittr
    - r-officer
    - r-rstudioapi
    - r-scales
    - r-stringr

test:
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('ztable')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('ztable')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: http://github.com/cardiomoon/ztable
  license: GPL-2.0-only
  summary: Makes zebra-striped tables (tables with alternating row colors) in LaTeX and HTML formats easily from a data.frame, matrix, lm, aov, anova, glm, coxph, nls, fitdistr, mytable and cbind.mytable objects.
  license_family: GPL2
  license_file:
    - {{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/GPL-2

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
